purpose: Check reviewed R97 local response against actual source and describe frozen R96 models; not independent utility confirmation or R95 rescue

data.selected_split: Existing R72 evaluation partition; no new cohort, sampling or official valid/test.

checkpoint_consumer: Post-training analysis only, existing local exact files; trusted pinned COS archive separately accepted, no cloud restore/read needed now
theory: R97 propositions1-4, eta0 local response. Matched construction/readout utilities only; same full norm for pinched control. No epsilon or eta1 theorem claim.
numerical_checks: Scalar nonnegative eta AD sums of own aggregates and CE, per-entry three-point positive one-sided finite differences h=1e-4; full/pinched/cross signed CE identity; geometry/unit norms and actual legacy eta0 logits. First fixtures precede any real-data model analysis.
fixtures: Source-circuit R94 witness with fixed harmful and helpful labels, same normalized construction
F=0 orthogonal-token counterexample at fixed source epsilon; response1/sqrt(3), zero cross
sample_selection: All972 existing R72 train-evaluation IDs in saved order, fixed before this execution; no outcome/case selection or new official valid/test. All4096 prefix authenticated by existing reader; no fitting.
output_meaning: Per model eta0 response summaries and eta0/deployed metrics. Deployed actual native/full/simplex source forward replays R96 metrics. Separate model weights and eta0 analysis from deployed eta1/full or simplex tilt. Class-response activity or positive H is not causal proof.
decision: Only ALGEBRA_AND_REPLAY_CHECKS_PASS_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY if frozen checks pass. H sign/metric comparisons are descriptive regardless of favorable outcome. No new utility tier, novelty, formal handoff or L5.
stop: Any source/input/hash/nonfinite/derivative/geometry/replay mismatch stops one attempt. Preserve exact failure; no tolerance, h, sample, seed, epsilon or epoch rescue.
limitations: One initialization and repeatedly explored training development cohort, missing fit/evaluation classes
Scalar AD checks aggregate sums; per-entry finite differences separately constrain cancellation
Theory assumes exactly normalized states; record floating norm/projector/log residuals, no silent repair
Eta0 local identities do not imply finite-eta benefit, Macro-F1 derivative or training causality
Established geometry specialization, nearest-work novelty unresolved; old scopedL4 unchanged
private_outputs: child-command.json, child-stdout.json, child-stderr.log only; no checkpoint/cache/array copies or per-example outputs
recovery: One attempt/no replay. Stop on mismatch. Existing models durable elsewhere; archive delivery never reruns science.
